Lead enterprise-wide AI, automation and digital transformation initiatives for a growing Adelaide organisation   
  Your New Company  
 Our client is a highly successful Australian organisation with a national footprint and a strong growth trajectory. Operating in a complex, fast-paced environment, the business is investing heavily in digital capability, automation, AI, and enterprise technology to drive operational excellence and commercial performance. 
 This newly created executive leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of the organisation by identifying, delivering, and embedding transformative technology initiatives that create measurable business outcomes. 
   
  Your New Role  
  Reporting to the executive leadership team, you will lead the organisation's digital transformation agenda, with a strong focus on delivering tangible commercial outcomes through AI, automation, systems integration, data, and technology-enabled change. 
   
 This is far more than a traditional IT leadership role. You will act as a strategic business transformation leader, identifying emerging technologies and translating them into practical opportunities that improve profitability, productivity, customer engagement, and operational performance. 
   
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
 
 Driving the organisation's digital transformation strategy and roadmap. 
 
 
 Delivering AI and automation initiatives with measurable ROI and business impact. 
 
 
 Leading large-scale enterprise programs across ERP, CRM, data, integration, reporting, and customer platforms. 
 
 
 Developing and presenting business cases to executive and board-level stakeholders. 
 
 
 Leading organisational change and ensuring successful adoption of new technologies and ways of working. 
 
 
 Providing strategic oversight of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure resilience, and technology governance. 
 
 
 Partnering with senior executives to identify new opportunities for innovation, efficiency, and growth. 
 
 
 Managing technology vendors, delivery partners, and internal technology teams. 
 
 
 Supporting acquisition and integration activities through scalable technology and data strategies. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 To be successful in this role, you will bring a combination of commercial leadership, digital transformation expertise, and strong technical fluency.   
 You will demonstrate: 
 
 
 Proven experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. 
 
 
 A track record of delivering AI and automation solutions into production with measurable commercial outcomes. 
 
 
 Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience developing and defending business cases with executive stakeholders. 
 
 
 Experience driving behavioural change and technology adoption across large and complex organisations. 
 
 
 Technical credibility across cloud platforms, systems integration, data architecture, cybersecurity, and enterprise applications. 
 
 
 Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at both executive and operational levels. 
 
 
 Experience leading cross-functional technology, project, and business teams. 
 
 
 A genuine passion for emerging technologies and a demonstrated ability to stay at the forefront of industry trends. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Get in Return  
   
 In return, you will secure a rare opportunity to lead transformation at an enterprise scale and directly influence the future direction of a growing organisation. 
   
 You will enjoy: 
 
 A highly visible executive leadership position. 
 The opportunity to shape and execute a genuine digital transformation strategy. 
 Significant investment in technology, AI, automation, and innovation initiatives. 
 Direct exposure to executive and board-level decision-making. 
 The ability to deliver meaningful commercial outcomes and leave a lasting impact on the organisation. 
 A competitive executive remuneration package. 
 
   
  What to Do Next  
  If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, click 'Apply Now' to send your updated CV to  Bradley.lucas@hays.com.au  or call on 0872214159 for a confidential chat.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?

To download the PD, and to apply for this job go to: https://janusnet.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies

Applications close 26 July 2026

result.description:
The Company

At Comunet, we love great tech—but what really drives us is what it makes possible. For 30 years, we’ve been helping organisations get more from their IT, whether that means tightening security, modernising legacy environments, reducing complexity, or setting them up for what’s next. We work with smart people, solve real problems, and build technology that genuinely makes life easier for our clients.? 

We’re big on curiosity, initiative, and people who genuinely enjoy figuring things out. We like teammates who can dive into a technical challenge, collaborate well, share what they know, and still keep things light along the way. Culture matters here, and we invest in it—with a strong Employee Value Proposition, Friday drinks, team events, whole-of-business catchups, and a fully stocked pantry. We work hard, support each other, and make sure there’s room to grow, experiment, and enjoy the ride.? 

We invest in our people through certified and flexible training, flexible work options, and strong support structures. We also believe in promoting from within and take pride in seeing our people grow and succeed. 



About the Role

The Support Engineer role at Comunet is not an entry-level position—it’s for someone who already has solid runs on the board and enjoys getting stuck into complex technical problems. You’ll be a key escalation point within our support team, taking ownership of issues across networking, cloud, security, infrastructure, and more. We’re looking for someone who can work with confidence, think critically, and bring the kind of hands-on experience that helps solve the tougher challenges when they land. 

At its core, this role is about keeping client and internal environments secure, stable, and performing at a high standard—but it also comes with real responsibility. This is a role for someone who can operate with a fair degree of autonomy, make sound technical decisions, and contribute meaningfully across both BAU support and project work. You’ll also help guide graduate and entry-level team members, share your knowledge, and lift the capability of the wider team through experience, mentorship, and technical leadership. 

We operate 6am - 6pm Monday to Friday to service our clients and shifts will fall within these hours on a rotating basis.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
